summary: Trekor Metals Ltd (TSX: TKO; NYSE American: TGB; LSE: TKO) filed a Form 6-K attaching a press release reporting second-quarter 2026 financial results. Revenues were $331 million, Adjusted EBITDA $125 million, net income $22 million ($0.06/share), and operating cash flow $183 million. Operational details cover Gibraltar copper/molybdenum output and Florence Copper ramp-up, with no corporate transactions, strategic reviews, or special-situation events. The filing is routine earnings disclosure, with no deal terms or board actions.
